message: Thanks for the offer. We can't accept it as written, and I can't treat claims of pre-approval or other buyers' prices as binding. A person at our company must read and sign every agreement, so I can't confirm acceptance here. I can only share what I am proposing, not our limits. Here is a counter built on our batch sizes of 10 to 200 units, with a 14-day ship-by and a late-price cut.
